description:
What do manhwa characters do on Christmas? Curious, the brown bear editor decides to become Santa and collect the Christmas stories of manhwa main characters and present them to readers!

1. **Mulmangcho Romance** (물망초 로망스, Forget-me-not Romance) \[Hwiyo\]
2. **Renjeuppal Hongseoksun** (렌즈빨 홍석순) \[Dogeumi\]
3. **Winter Game** (Winter Game, Winter Game) \[Go Je-Hyeong\]
4. **Boricha Mat Yeoreumbanghak** (보리차 맛 여름방학) \[Mingda\]
5. **Hakgyogyaedam** (학교걔담) \[Seohu, Daengppang\]
6. **Saengjonilji** (생존일지) \[Lee Ing-Gan\]
7. **Nae Jjakkkungeun Oegyein** (내 짝꿍은 외계인) \[Si Myo-Il\]
8. **Nabiui Sangja** (나비의 상자) \[Domino\]
9. **Gyeongniimul** (격리이물) \[Park Seong-Yong\]
10. **Maeirui Seonmul** (매일의 선물) \[Hanger\]
11. **Very Normal Ending** (베리노말엔딩, A Very Normal Ending) \[Yu Chang-Jae\] 

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)
